form.message: Fulcrum's state is recovered. The indicative transfer-rate request is complete, but your latest scope restriction keeps monthly totals, manifest writeback and Architecture approval blocked while app transfer usage is unknown. The saved pricing ledger is 34/34; no further queries are authorized. Choose whether to keep that pause or explicitly return to monthly-cost planning. No traffic volume will be assumed, and existing evidence will be reused before considering any additional pricing requests.
